Backend: 7/7 pytest passing on /api/content/programs (full nested keys), admin PUT round-trip persistence for programs and about. 'Why Progress Stalls After the Basics' + 'What You'll Develop' + 4 problem points, Testimonials 7/7 with Vikram & Ananya, FAQ 25/25 with all 11 Q/A entries). Intermediate FAQ count verified. critical_code_review_comments: ProgramEditor field names now mirror public-page schema (problem.headline, problem.points, overview.headline, overview.features, testimonials[{name,text}], faq[{q,a}]) — admin/public parity achieved. Good practice.

useContent() has 5-minute localStorage cache — admin saves do not invalidate the cache. Currently visible by force-reload but end users with stale cache will see old data up to 5 min. Consider bumping cache or adding an invalidation hook on admin PUT. Not blocking.
Modal in ProgramEditor lacks role='dialog'/aria-modal attributes; minor accessibility gap (auto Escape close still works via React state but a11y testing would flag this). Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — verified existing seed via GET /api/content/programs returning 3 programs with foundations/beginner/intermediate IDs and correct nested counts (faq 7/11/9, testimonials 2 each, problem.points 4 each, overview.features 6 each). Test created and rolled back: TEST_ROUNDTRIP_TAGLINE on Beginner, TEST_PHILOSOPHY_HEADLINE on About — both restored after assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_programs_about_coaching.py covers full programs nested schema, admin save round-trip with data-integrity (verifies faq.length stays 11 after a beginner tagline edit), and about philosophy round-trip. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. ProgramEditor modal can be located via clicking nth Edit button (0=foundations, 1=beginner, 2=intermediate). Public Beginner detail at /programs → 'View Full Details' on Beginner card renders 11 FAQs from the seed. Razorpay still blocked — do not test payment endpoints.
rca of the issue: ORIGINAL BUG: ProgramEditor used legacy field names (description, heroTitle, whatYouGet, whoFor, faqs) while seed_content.py only seeded a minimal {id, title, level, duration} shape — so when admin opened Edit on Beginner the Detail/FAQ tabs had nothing to bind to. FIX (already applied by E1): (a) DEFAULT_PROGRAMS in seed_content.py now contains the full rich schema (shortDesc, sessions, setting, primaryFocus, problem.{headline,points}, overview.{headline,features}, testimonials, faq, bullets, image, programLink, status) for foundations/beginner/intermediate; (b) ProgramEditor.jsx rewrites to consume those same field paths across Card/Detail Page/Testimonials/FAQ tabs; (c) DB was force re-seeded by removing db.content_documents['programs'] then restarting backend so ensure_seed_content() inserts the new defaults. VERIFIED in this iteration: Beginner editor now shows 'Why Progress Stalls After the Basics', 4 problem points, 'What You'll Develop' + 6 overview features, Vikram & Ananya testimonials, and all 11 FAQ entries pre-populated.
